Session.TurnNeverDecreases.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn >= before.turn

Session.TurnAdvancesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn <= before.turn + 1

Session.ModelRequestsStartedNeverDecreas.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started >= before.model_requests_started

Session.InterruptFlagStaysSetDuringSameT.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupt_requested ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.interrupt_requested
